sn42.8:1.5: Mahāvīra is quoted as saying that a person who “always kills movable and immovable beings for the sake of his own comfort, who injures them, who takes what is not freely given, who does not train in self-control, the impudent sinner who injures many beings without relenting will go to hell.” (Sūtrakṛtāṅga 1.5.1.4–5, adapted from Jacobi translation).
